Package grpcdc

Class SidecarTransport

java.lang.Object
grpcdc.SidecarTransport
All Implemented Interfaces:
Transport
public final class SidecarTransport extends Object implements Transport
Transport over the Rust WebRTC-Direct sidecar: the sidecar owns DTLS/SCTP/TURN and bridges one datachannel to a local TCP socket using u32 big-endian length-prefixed messages (one prefix per DataChannel message). JDK only.
